title: Takelma–Kalapuyan languages - Wikipedia
text: The Kalapuyan languages and Takelma were spoken in two discontiguous areas: while Kalapuyan speakers inhabited the Willamette Valley, Takelma speakers lived in the Rogue Valley in the southernmost part of Oregon. In between, the Athabaskan Upper Umpqua language was spoken.
